title: High-Density GPU Computing Rigs
summary: 330 kVA industrial-grade multi-GPU computing cluster engineered in a private Bandung facility with custom power distribution and high-velocity ventilation.
highlights: 330 kVA 3-phase industrial power drop with balanced phase distribution and server PSU DC rails.
Custom slotted-angle steel racking with high-flow negative-pressure industrial window ventilation.
Zero-touch stateless recovery combined with CryptoSlax across hundreds of 24/7 compute GPUs.
